_about: Public-domain Frédéric Ozanam (1813-1853, historian and founder of the Society of St Vincent de Paul) in English for the Word Hoard: History of Civilization in the Fifth Century tr. Ashley C. Glyn (2 vols, 1867), his Letters tr. Ainslie Coates (1886), Dante and Catholic Philosophy in the Thirteenth Century tr. Lucia D. Pychowska (1897), The Franciscan Poets in Italy tr. A. E. Nellen and N. C. Craig (1914), and A Pilgrimage to the Land of the Cid, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
